searches.query: Anisotropic distributional total variation via smooth compactly supported test fields with infinity-norm bound; bounded variation/divergence search and inspection of smoothness, compact support, derivatives and integration.
searches.result: The coordinate derivatives of a smooth test field and a finite diagonal sum express divergence, while integration and a supremum over bounded test fields describe the functional. The test-field norm choice is essential to its anisotropic meaning.

library_audit.gap: The remaining interface bundles admissible test fields compactly supported inside U and their extended supremum, retaining the infinity-norm constraint and distributional interpretation.

variant_reviews.comparison: Require f in L1(U) with the TV from D1 finite, using restricted Lebesgue measure and the infinity-bounded test-field convention. This class is defined modulo null-set changes in its intended analytic interpretation, unlike unrestricted pointwise variation sensitive to isolated changes. Do not substitute BoundedVariationOn, whose domain is linearly ordered and whose variation uses pointwise distances. The essential-variation slicing theorem is an additional statement relating this BV class to almost-everywhere coordinate slices, not part of its definition.
